name: unix_commands
description: Retrieve standard Unix command names from filesystem-operation descriptions. Controls copy the supplied path without choosing a command.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
operations={'change the current directory to this path':'cd','list entries in this directory':'ls','create this directory':'mkdir','remove this empty directory':'rmdir','display the entire contents of this text file':'cat','display the first lines of this text file':'head','display the last lines of this text file':'tail','create this empty file or update its timestamp':'touch'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 op=list(operations)[i%len(operations)];path=random.choice(['sample','notes','archive','work','draft','project','logs','data']);p=f'Path: {path}. Task: {op}.\n'
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the standard Unix command name, no arguments or flags. Answer:','answer':' '+operations[op]})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the path, no command. Answer:','answer':' '+path})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
